usage: jbus queue add [-h] --priority PRIORITY [--depends DEPENDS]
                      [--merge-after MERGE_AFTER] [--entry ENTRY]
                      [--item ITEM]
                      slug

Queue a row, with its brief on stdin. A follow-up: a row is a follow-up of the
row P, and jbus approves it by the home's follow-up rule when it is queued,
when it names P (its brief's head has a line `Follows: P`, or its slug is
`cleanup-P`), when it is P's (its slug is `cleanup-P`, or its --entry is P's
plan entry), and when P's go is the user's own and holds (P is a row of the
queue, or went as merged, and was approved by the user's word and not by a
rule); any other row waits for the user's go. The home's follow-rule file
names that rule of its standing.md, and with no such file no row is approved
by rule when it is queued.

positional arguments:
  slug

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --priority PRIORITY   an integer, lower first
  --depends DEPENDS     slugs that must be merged before this row launches,
                        with commas: each one the brief's Builds on: line
                        names
  --merge-after MERGE_AFTER
                        slugs whose pull requests merge before this row's,
                        with commas: jmerge waits
  --entry ENTRY         the plan entry the row is work for, when not its own
                        slug
  --item ITEM           the work item the row is, by its id; with none, one is
                        made
